name: frontier: shipped(A) vs v4.1 rerender(B)
claim: At 2 W two-photon drive barium's decay-limited two-qubit gate infidelity sits below the Rb/Cs/Sr/Yb references across 40 <= n <= 100 at both 4 K and 300 K; at equal 20 mW power the barium ceiling rises into the reference band.

name: lifetime: shipped(A) vs v4.1 rerender(B)
claim: The Ba 1G4 Rydberg lifetime grows as a power of n, exceeds the Rb nS and Sr 3S1 reference lifetimes at 300 K, and stays far below the 7.1 ms value quoted by Shi2025.

name: level diagram: hand TikZ(A) vs levelspec(B)
claim: Barium level scheme: 1S0 ground, 1D2 E2 qubit at 877.6 nm, 3D shelving manifold, 553.7 nm cooling to 1P1, 791.3 nm intercombination to 3P1, two-photon Rydberg path 1D2 -> 1F3 (648.5 nm) -> 6sng 1G4 (657.9 nm) below the ionization limit; 1P1 decays to the ground state.
